name: dewa-sap-spec-builder
description: Functional and development specifications for SAP, inside VS Code – with read-only SAP system discovery through GitHub Copilot and the SAP MCP servers.

dewaSpecBuilder.discoveryTools.markdownDescription: Tool-name patterns (`*` wildcard) of the SAP MCP servers that **automatic discovery** may use. Tools whose names contain a write verb (create, update, delete, activate, transport, …) are always excluded.

dewaSpecBuilder.maxToolRounds.description: Maximum number of tool-calling rounds for automatic discovery.

dewaSpecBuilder.model.markdownDescription: Copilot model for **automatic discovery**, by family or name (e.g. `claude-sonnet`, `gpt-5`). Empty = the strongest available model; small models (Haiku, mini, flash) are used only when nothing else is available.

dewaSpecBuilder.chatAutoSend.markdownDescription: Send the prompt in Copilot Chat right away when a Spec Builder button opens Chat (development spec to `dewa-abap`, discovery in Chat, draft in Chat, review of a functional spec). Off: the prompt is only filled in and you press Enter.

dewaSpecBuilder.gates.markdownDescription: Approval gates. **enforce** (default): a functional spec must be approved before Technical specs are created from it (G1), and a technical spec before `dewa-abap` builds from it (G2). **warn**: the gates only warn, and continuing is recorded in the audit trail. IT can set and lock this setting.

dewaSpecBuilder.gates.requireSapCheck.markdownDescription: A technical spec can be approved only after *Check & read in SAP* has run with no unresolved findings.

dewaSpecBuilder.approvers.functional.markdownDescription: GitHub accounts (as shown in VS Code's Accounts menu) that may **approve functional specifications** (gate G1). Empty = nobody can approve, so enforced gates stay closed. Example: `["fs-lead", "ba-manager"]`. IT distributes it in user or workspace settings (`.vscode/settings.json`); see GOVERNANCE.md.

dewaSpecBuilder.approvers.technical.markdownDescription: GitHub accounts that may **approve technical specifications** (gate G2, before `dewa-abap` builds). Example: `["tech-lead"]`. IT distributes it in user or workspace settings (`.vscode/settings.json`); see GOVERNANCE.md.

dewaSpecBuilder.installAgent.description: Install the dewa-fs-discovery agent into the VS Code prompts folder on start-up (an edited copy is never replaced).

languageModelTools.name: dewa_submitContextPack
languageModelTools.displayName: Send context pack to SAP Spec Builder
languageModelTools.userDescription: Imports the SAP system context pack into the open SAP Spec Builder.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Call this once at the end of a dewa-fs-discovery run with the complete dewa-sap-context-pack JSON object. It imports the pack into the SAP Spec Builder panel. It does not change anything in SAP.

languageModelTools.name: dewa_submitFsDraft
languageModelTools.displayName: Send draft to SAP Spec Builder
languageModelTools.userDescription: Sends an AI draft of a functional specification to the open SAP Spec Builder for review.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Call this once at the end of a functional-specification draft with the complete fs-draft JSON object (kind "fs-draft", version 1). The SAP Spec Builder shows it to the user for review; nothing is added without the user's choice. It does not change any files or systems.

languageModelTools.name: dewa_submitDevContext
languageModelTools.displayName: Send SAP check to SAP Spec Builder
languageModelTools.userDescription: Sends the read-only SAP check of a development specification (Check & read in SAP) to the open SAP Spec Builder for review.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Call this once at the end of a 'DEV-CONTEXT v1' run with the complete dewa-dev-context JSON object (kind "dewa-dev-context", version 1): the checked object names, the existing objects read and notFound. The SAP Spec Builder shows it to the developer for review; nothing is taken over without the developer's choice. It does not change any files or systems.
